summary: Wide street with cars parked both sides, but homes within about 20 m all round.

drivers.seclusion: Granville Court and other apartments 17-18 m ahead; houses 15-21 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane with many parked cars; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Residential street, rail corridor to the west adds some noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both sides, so a van blends in.

sun_shade: Open to sun; some tree shade from the north verge near 100 m.

best_section.where: Alpha Street north kerb, towards the east bend before Granville Court
